name: PullCordReveal
job: Reveal a second image or offer under the first by pulling a hanging cord that lowers a roller shade
visitor_action: drag the brass cord down or click it to lower the shade; arrow down and up when focused; click the window to toggle
mobile: big cord handle at the edge, tap also works
motion: Pull: cord drags with the pointer (leans sideways), pulley spins, linen unwinds from the roll and its hem emerges with a hanging shadow; on release the shade overshoots and settles with a slight lean, the ring springs and bounces, the cord swings and the tag lags as a second pendulum. Reduced motion: instant toggle, static scene.
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Dusk window seen straight on: painted deep-green sash window with mitred casing, deep reveal and mullions over a warm-graded restaurant view; woven ecru linen roller shade on a fixed brass axle with brass end brackets, pulley arm and twisted cord; turned wooden acorn and ring pull with a paper tag. Warm amber window glow against a dark wall, ring and tag as the focal point.
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5). Rebuilt hardware, linen weave/translucency, window depth and dusk lighting after Guy's 'ugly' verdict. Visual quality unverified (no screenshots per token-saving directive). Cord drag span scales with window height; tap-to-toggle and arrow keys cover small windows. 2026-11-24: de-skeuomorphic pass: dusk saturation and ember glow removed (natural light); bracket/pulley/ring/acorn simplified and scaled toward real objects; thinner cord; linen slub/ghost-bar texture removed.
